{
  "method": "data-parallel over inputs",
  "rationale": "First ranked feasible method; deterministic GPU resource guards already passed. Treat eight existing independent replica jobs as input work items on one GPU under MPS, preserving the fixed workload. Profile: kernels 55.76032713564045%, CUDA API host time 43.864266680809005%, H2D 0.026259324571666304%, D2H 0.3491468589788642%, other host time 0%. Whole-workload measured concurrent-throughput bound is 1.996429795519112x with p=1 and k=min(8,1.996429795519112); this is a cap, not a promised gain or an integer worker count. Concurrent independent jobs can overlap host submission gaps and GPU work; utilization is unavailable, so low GPU utilization is not inferred. Transfers total only 0.3754061835505305%; supplied pipelining bound is 1.0018805607884955x. Multi-GPU is infeasible with one GPU. Preserve the sealed method and scientific protocol.",
  "plan_steps": [
    "In a later implementation phase, locate the existing eight-replica driver and separate orchestration from the unchanged single-replica calculation. Dispatch existing replica inputs rather than introduce replicas or split dependent trajectory steps.",
    "Use a bounded process worker pool on the same GPU with MPS enabled. Start with two concurrent workers; retain the supplied cap of eight and passed resource constraints. Initialize isolated OpenMM contexts inside workers, avoid sharing live CUDA contexts, and amortize worker startup within each fixed-work execution where compatible with existing timing boundaries.",
    "For replica i preserve seed0+i for both velocities and integrator RNG, original input, forces, integrator, precision, DeterministicForces=true, step counts, sampling, and all other scientific settings. Isolate temporary/output paths by execution and replica; collect exactly eight results in original replica order and preserve output schema and aggregation.",
    "Measure complete fixed-work ensemble elapsed time under the unchanged timing protocol on identical hardware, including orchestration and overheads required by its timing boundaries. Compare equal-work one-GPU throughput; report measured speedup against the 1.996429795519112x cap without changing workload, timing repetitions, or protocol to improve results.",
    "Apply the sealed paired-median equivalence test on the single input using all 32 seed0 values: 2000, 2008, 2016, 2024, 2032, 2040, 2048, 2056, 2064, 2072, 2080, 2088, 2096, 2104, 2112, 2120, 2128, 2136, 2144, 2152, 2160, 2168, 2176, 2184, 2192, 2200, 2208, 2216, 2224, 2232, 2240, 2248. Pair baseline and method on identical seed0, input, and hardware. Each execution remains one eight-replica fixed-work ensemble with disjoint seed blocks.",
    "For each of 16 replica energy metrics, take median method-minus-baseline difference across timing repetitions within each seed block. Form the exact order-statistic confidence interval using ranks 8 and 25 of the 32 seed-level differences, with per-tail alpha=0.0015625 and family confidence 0.95. Require every interval to lie within its fixed symmetric absolute margin: 37.70105566975365 kJ/mol for each replica mean potential and 155.63975549295594 kJ/mol for each replica final potential. Do not treat repetitions as independent scientific samples or revise margins, sample sizes, method, or protocol after observing results."
  ],
  "files_expected": [
    "Existing eight-replica orchestration source; exact path absent from packet, to be identified only during an authorized implementation phase.",
    "Existing launch configuration for single-GPU MPS and bounded replica workers; exact path absent from packet.",
    "Existing result collection source, only if required to preserve ordered output from concurrent replicas; exact path absent from packet."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Worker startup, serialization, context initialization, MPS scheduling, CPU contention, output I/O, GPU contention, and tail imbalance can reduce realized speedup below the measured concurrency bound. Passed resource guards establish feasibility, not guaranteed performance.",
    "Concurrent scheduling can change floating-point execution and stochastic trajectories despite identical seeds and DeterministicForces=true. Independent RNG state, per-replica seed assignment, original settings, and isolated contexts must remain intact; bitwise agreement is not assumed.",
    "Shared files, completion-order aggregation, omitted or duplicated replicas, or seed reassignment would change scientific results. Preserve replica identity and verify complete fixed-work output before equivalence assessment.",
    "Margins derive from sample SD across only eight baseline seeds 1000-1007 divided by sqrt(8): 106.63468848789736 kJ/mol for mean potential and 440.21570612514148 kJ/mol for final potential. These noisy scientific resolution estimates are neither same-seed repeat variability nor published tolerances; apply them unchanged to each replica median paired difference.",
    "Conditional family-power lower bound 0.9999699963373421 assumes independent seed blocks and at most 0.025 probability in each tail beyond each metric's margin. Method-difference distribution is unmeasured; unconditional achieved power is unavailable. Single-input evidence limits generalization."
  ]
}
